_notes: Responses the emulator serves locally. Everything not listed here is proxied to StarBackend.
config: keyed 'group/key'. A null entry answers NOT_FOUND (kept here so the boot-time keys stay visible).
A string value is served verbatim; an object value is serialised to JSON before it is served.
instances: Instance messages in proto-JSON. shard_id '*' is replaced by the shard_id the client asked for.
push_on_listen: messages pushed the moment a PushService.Listen stream opens; type is the full message name.
Enums are given as their measured numbers so the fixture also matches the real descriptor set.

grpc/endpoints._notes: Shape unknown until CCIGServices::LoadChannelConfiguration (0x140FAC050) is read. Keys 'endpoints', 'queues', 'channels' were seen in the loader. Disabled until then.

services/instance_manager_external._notes: Never requested by the client as of Addendum E. Inner keys unknown; served only when the client asks. Mirror the shape identity_external comes back with once captured.

instances._notes: One stowed personal hangar. instance_oc_path names a socpak that exists in the P4K.
